notes.title: Update 2 - 7 March 2025
notes.content:
Here goes second update! This small patch includes:

[list]
[*] 10 new tables added, mainly Buddhism related.
[*] Added feedback after failed tests.
[*] Fix of the issue with duplicated answers handling.
[*] Hexagram visual help fix (Sun was not clickable).
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1 - 16 Feb 2025
notes.content:
First update is here! Week after launch we would like to present you small patch including:

[list]
[*]New skills related to Chinese Cosmos found in Book of Thoth, containing placement of the I Ching trigrams on the Tree of Life, their Chinese and English names, western attributions by Crowley and corresponding parts of body. 
[*]Colour scales learning improvement. Proper scale is visible on Tree of Life only in Guided mode, all further practices use random scales to help using memorized colours. 
[*]Stability fixes. Including case with crashing Practice in some circumstances.
[*]Other bug fixes.
[/list]
